_comment: Where each reference guide came from. The guides themselves are copyrighted
by their authors and may not be redistributed, so references/*.txt is
gitignored and every user fetches their own copy.
key      short name, also the filename stem under references/
url      GameFAQs page for the specific guide the parsers expect
credit   which guide it is, so the right one is fetched if a page changes
